reviewMethod: Fourteen newly selected body figures across five current-corpus papers were independently reviewed from immutable read-only GitHub evidence artifact 10785035374. Each approval was checked against DOI-bound task/page/article provenance, original figure/scheme identity and independent caption, direct ACS/Silverchair source path, capture protocol 6.2.20, fixed media generation 1790082000000, exact frozen bytes and full SHA256, image role, paper theme, visual clarity, duplicate/same-ID risk, and evidence fingerprint. SVG files were rendered on a white background and inspected as complete chemistry figures; each SVG is self-contained with no script, foreignObject, javascript URL, external href, or event-handler content. PNG files decoded cleanly at the stored dimensions. Figure 1 items are explicitly approved as article body figures and are not TOC substitutes. Partial article-level capture reports for JACS 10.1021/jacs.6c12613, 10.1021/jacs.6c16346, and 10.1021/jacs.6c15393 are treated only as provenance/history: approval is limited to the exact individually verified stored files and does not imply missing article figures are approved. Earlier transport/format checkpoints are not interpreted as VPN/R2/quota causes. No publisher recrawl, R2/D1 write, server-side direct import/repair, literature-data change, userscript change, or production deployment is authorized by this packet.
